text:
Predicates:
F1(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
J1(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
WorkInUS(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
NeedsToApply(x, y) ::: x needs to apply for y.
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student.
Premises:
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) → (F1(x) ∨ J1(x))) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) ∧ F1(x) ∧ WorkInUS(x)) → (NeedsToApply(x, CPT) ∨ NeedsToApply(x, OPT)) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if the student wants to work in the US.
InternationalStudent(mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
WorkInUS(mike) ::: Mike wants to work in the US.
NeedsToApply(mike, CPT) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.
Conclusion:
F1(mike) ::: Mike has an F1 visa.
